verdict.rationale: An audit log of cap-table changes is a fair axis for a cap-table platform, but the evidence never documents one recording who changed what, when, and under what authorization. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: API delta sync of changed rows, historical transaction import with attached documents, and tracking of market orders.

support.subject: As an ops user, every change to the cap table is captured in an audit log — who changed what, when, and under what authorization
